hero.title: Premium fashion and accessories for women who want quality and clarity.
hero.description: ATLAS Wear brings together authentic, brand new products for customers in Romania, the USA, and internationally. No complicated checkout, no unnecessary redirects, just a clean selection, competitive pricing, and direct ordering.

home.trustShippingDesc: Romania, USA, and international delivery support with direct communication.
home.trustPricingDesc: Aggressively positioned reseller pricing without sacrificing trust or clarity.
